SELECT s.format, f.staff_purchase_flag staff,
 count(*) lines, sum(f.net_amount) sales_net, sum(f.quantity) units,
 count(r.sales_line_id) ret_lines, sum(r.refund_net) refund_net, sum(r.quantity_returned) ret_units,
 sum(CASE WHEN r.quantity_returned>f.quantity THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) over_qty,
 sum(CASE WHEN r.refund_net>f.net_amount+0.01 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) over_val,
 sum(CASE WHEN r.return_date<f.sale_date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) early,
 max(r.return_date) maxret
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key LEFT JOIN fact_return_line r ON r.sales_line_id=f.sales_line_id
WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN '2025-05-26' AND '2025-06-22' GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY ALL

SELECT 'stg' src, count(*) n, count(DISTINCT return_line_id) d, sum(CASE WHEN return_line_id IN (SELECT return_line_id FROM fact_return_line) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) in_fact, min(return_date), max(return_date) FROM stg_return_line_load
UNION ALL SELECT 'stg_sales', count(*), count(DISTINCT sales_line_id), sum(CASE WHEN sales_line_id IN (SELECT sales_line_id FROM fact_sales_line) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), min(sale_date), max(sale_date) FROM stg_sales_line_load
UNION ALL SELECT 'ret_by_month_p2', count(*), 0,0, min(return_date), max(return_date) FROM fact_return_line WHERE return_date BETWEEN '2025-05-26' AND '2025-06-22'

SELECT d.calendar_date, d.is_trading_day, d.holiday_name, count(f.sales_line_id) n FROM dim_date d LEFT JOIN fact_sales_line f ON f.sale_date=d.calendar_date AND f.channel_code='ST' WHERE d.calendar_date BETWEEN '2025-05-26' AND '2025-06-22' GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1

SELECT s.format, sum(r.net_sales_before_returns) rpt_gross, sum(r.returns_net) rpt_ret, sum(r.units_sold) u,
 (SELECT sum(f.net_amount) FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s2 ON s2.store_key=f.store_key WHERE s2.format=s.format AND f.sale_date BETWEEN '2025-05-26' AND '2025-06-22' AND f.channel_code='ST') all_incl_staff,
 (SELECT sum(f.net_amount) FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s2 ON s2.store_key=f.store_key WHERE s2.format=s.format AND f.sale_date BETWEEN '2025-05-26' AND '2025-06-22' AND f.channel_code='ST' AND NOT f.staff_purchase_flag) excl_staff
FROM rpt_daily_store_sales r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_id=r.store_id AND r.business_date BETWEEN s.valid_from AND s.valid_to
WHERE r.business_date BETWEEN '2025-05-26' AND '2025-06-22' GROUP BY s.format

WITH sold AS (
  SELECT s.format, f.sales_line_id, f.net_amount, f.quantity, f.staff_purchase_flag
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
  WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-05-26' AND DATE '2025-06-22'
    AND f.channel_code = 'ST'
    AND s.store_id < 900
), agg AS (
  SELECT sold.format,
         sum(sold.net_amount) AS sales_net,
         coalesce(sum(r.refund_net), 0) AS refund_net,
         sum(sold.quantity) AS units_sold,
         coalesce(sum(r.quantity_returned), 0) AS units_returned,
         sum(CASE WHEN NOT sold.staff_purchase_flag THEN sold.net_amount END) AS sales_net_xstaff,
         sum(CASE WHEN NOT sold.staff_purchase_flag THEN r.refund_net END) AS refund_net_xstaff
  FROM sold LEFT JOIN fact_return_line r ON r.sales_line_id = sold.sales_line_id
  GROUP BY sold.format
)
SELECT 'FY2025/26' AS fiscal_year, 2 AS fiscal_period, format AS store_format,
       round(100 * refund_net / sales_net, 2) AS return_rate_pct,
       round(100 * units_returned / units_sold, 2) AS unit_rate_pct,
       round(100 * refund_net_xstaff / sales_net_xstaff, 2) AS xstaff_rate_pct,
       sales_net, refund_net
FROM agg ORDER BY CASE format WHEN 'Large' THEN 1 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END
